title: Support status
description: Two orthogonal axes — model_status and solver_status — per OBJECT-MODEL.md §10. Anti-placeholder Rule 4 forbids 'pass by absence': every behavior must carry a solver_status; missing or absent is not a valid state.

model_status.description: Completeness of the entry itself. 'defined' = all required fields + provenance. 'partial_but_real' = some honest absences. 'needs_more_sources' = single citation; cross-reference pending. 'deprecated' = superseded.

solver_status.description: What the validator can do with this. 'not_applicable' = not a solvable thing (materials, shapes). 'defined_not_solved' = the honesty mechanism — known phenomenon, no solver yet. 'builtin_simple' = direct compute. 'builtin_approximation' = rule-of-thumb. 'warning_only' = detect + warn, no compute. 'external_solver' = route to ngspice/Yosys. 'research_future' = known, not implemented at any level.
